full_p_policy: The same first100 of1000 seeds in each cell and each engine/scheme complete allB599, selected before confirmation outcomes. Confirm mean p-shift using per-dataset averages of the three matched pair differences D minus U and seed-level Monte Carlo uncertainty. Per-pair and global-max p-values are separate. This sample does not establish precise tail probabilities, B convergence, equivalence, or noninferiority.
failure_policy: Preserve all planned datasets and unsuccessful fits. Unknown planned outcomes may yield exact decisions via fixed-budget bounds; never change denominator to successful fits.
primary_endpoint: REF repaired unrestricted-minus-diagnosis complete-null Bonferroni FWER paired difference; IID control and original/repaired sensitivity. Global-max error is separately reported. Pointwise Monte Carlo intervals, no equivalence claim from inclusion of .05.
paired_total_timeout_policy: Shared original/repaired job total budget is twice the single-fit timeout. Preserve any completed first result on abort.
secondary_p_endpoint: Mean over100 independent dataset-level averages of p_D minus p_U across the three pairs, separately by cell and engine; paired bootstrap at dataset level, not300 flattened p-values.
execution_implementation: Direct normal-PDF objective changes only distribution-object construction. Enable after HPC full optimizer/mixture/output exact-equivalence checks and same-seed B3 batch bridge; original/repaired share mixture only within a single identical-input job.
freeze_policy: Immutable source/config snapshot created before any42xxxxxx confirmation data are generated. Earlier41xxxxxx structural-preflight data are excluded. Changes prompted by confirmation outcomes require a new candidate and fresh seeds.
